settings.description_text: We provide daily cage changing, health monitoring (including weekends & holidays), vivarium sanitization plus receiving of animals and all cage components.
Our team handles supply and animal orders, vendor coordination, regulatory compliance, SOP generation, and equipment maintenance to keep your vivarium facility running smoothly.
We support your research with dosing, necropsy, breeding management, and post-operative care, ensuring precision and consistency.
With our comprehensive suite of support services such as vivarium design, inventory management, preventative maintenance, room fogging, veterinary support, and staff training, we've got you covered.

settings.title: Our experience working with Innovive for animal care, husbandry, and technical services has been highly impressive. The onboarding process was smooth, and the entire Innovive team has been incredibly responsive to our communications and requests. One of the initial projects undertaken by Innovive was organizing and improving the labeling of our animal housing rooms. This has received positive feedback from our researchers as it has increased the efficiency of their studies by reducing the time spent looking for animals. We appreciate the Innovive staff is dedicated to both the welfare of the animals and the advancement of science, ensuring robust scientific research is conducted in an ethical manner. The vivarium management has been exceptional, handling facility operations, collaborating with our veterinarian, implementing policy changes, managing technicians, and ensuring the smooth functioning of the facility.
